purpose: Mechanical validation of sensitivity and recovery under known synthetic observation operations; no empirical Mexico error model or physical causal attribution.

latent.model: Own finite-horizon ETAS-type branching generator with Gaussian spatial offspring; not the original Ogata implementation or an empirical MLE fit

randomness.replication_justification: Thirty independent histories per regime bound the run at 960 dependent factorial B cells plus clean A histories. Report history-level SD, SE and t29 95% Monte Carlo interval; no target precision, significance or acceptance is guaranteed and no favourable-result stopping is permitted. Three separate development histories calibrate cuts without concatenating histories before parent search.

observations.A: All latent events; reported magnitude rounded to 0.1 using decimal half-up; coordinates from true xy; UTC rounded to microseconds; synthetic depth 10 km.
observations.D: Retain iff ledger uniform < 0.65 + 0.30*clip((latent_M-3.5)/1.5,0,1); this drops context and evaluation records alike.
observations.M: Add +0.15 + Normal(0,0.15) to clean reported magnitude, then decimal half-up to 0.1.
observations.X: Add xy bias (+2,-2) km plus independent Normal(0,5) km offsets, then inverse-project.
observations.T: Add +2 + Normal(0,2) seconds to clean UTC, rounded to microseconds.
observations.ledger: One fixed set of independent observation draws per latent record reused in all 16 cells; no field-dependent redraws. Identity, root, parent and raw errors stored separately from detector inputs.
observations.inclusion: Missing, observed below native reported-M cut, and retained are distinct states. Evaluation membership is fixed by latent 0<=t<730; clock perturbations do not silently redefine the target population. All observed burn records above cut supply history.
observations.identity_primary: Known shared latent ID; source IDs order equivalent for exact UTC ties, no truth supplied to NN/GK or matcher.
observations.matching_secondary: Existing actual maximum-cardinality minimum-integer-cost SSN-USGS candidate assigner, synthetic A adapted as source ssn and B as usgs, time window 30 s inclusive, epicentral distance 50 km inclusive. Adapter labels do not claim observed agency data. Precision/recall compared against retained shared latent identities.

detectors.NN: Canonical author-2013 v3 implementation: d=1.6, w=1, q=0.5, R=6367.3 km, strictly earlier parents, stable UTC/ID ties; author fit uses eta_log10, family cut uses log10(TN)+log10(RN), inclusive threshold.
detectors.primary_cut: Fit author_normalmix to pooled finite eta_log10 values from separate clean A development searches; freeze one cut for all test regimes and B cells. No test truth used.
detectors.secondary_cut: Fit a separate cut per B factorial cell from separate searches of that cell in the same three development histories. Test A retains clean-A cut. This reports calibration sensitivity, not an independently selected favourable analysis.
detectors.mixture_failures: Save full fit and mode/BIC diagnostic. A failed fit gives unavailable NN labels and counts as a failure; no fallback from observed Mexico or reseeding. The two-mode BIC guard does not suppress an estimable operational result.
detectors.GK: Existing local continuous-UTC magnitude-priority Gardner-Knopoff baseline, R=6371.0088 km, foreshock fraction 0.5; own implementation previously checked against indexed/all-candidate predicate.

targets_and_metrics.truth_independent: Parent/root truth comes only from branching generation, never from NN or GK. Observed-family roles are recomputed per catalogue on retained members of each latent root: singleton, largest retained reported-M representative with UTC/ID ties, other associated. A hidden true parent does not convert a generated child to an immigrant.
recovery: Generated-child precision/recall/F1 and true-immigrant false-positive fraction, separate from operational maximum-retained roles
baselines: all one observed family with its largest-retained representative
targets_and_metrics.cross_catalogue: On fixed clean-A evaluation keys above cut: denominator, B missing, B below cut, retained both, conditional role confusion/ARI and fixed-denominator total state disagreement. Also report B-only entrants. Never relabel inclusion losses as classification errors without the separate counts.
targets_and_metrics.factorial: For each method/cut branch and response, all 16 cells and exact Boolean-lattice Mobius interactions per independent history; these are conditional operation responses, not percentages of physical causation or a unique additive attribution.
targets_and_metrics.matching: Store assigned endpoints and candidate edges. Match precision/recall against shared latent identities; operational role agreement on actual assignments reported separately from known-identity primary agreement.
targets_and_metrics.uncertainty: Mean of history-level metrics with nonmissing n, SD, SE and Student t interval using df=n-1; pooled confusion/counts supplied separately. No treating 16 cells within a history as independent replicates. Degenerate or undefined denominators remain null.

audit.prior_results: Do not overwrite or omit earlier 120-case synthetic and 24-case anchored results; previous NN generated-child F1 0.5542555 and GK 0.684 versus trivial 0.691 remain adverse descriptive evidence, not claimed statistical inferiority.
audit.execution_gate: No scientific generation or benchmark until root master protocol and CPU permission; tiny software fixtures may run beforehand.
outputs: complete observation ledger and derived catalogue rows
per-cell NN parent/score/labels arrays and GK labels
summary with Monte Carlo uncertainty and replay hashes

limitations: Synthetic assumed errors are not real-agency measurement errors or Mexico representativeness.
Finite burn, finite horizon, Gaussian spatial kernel and two regimes do not span all seismicity.
Generated child labels and largest-retained operational roles answer different questions.
Exact-input A=B is a software control, not the scientific success criterion.
Nonlinear factorial responses have interactions and do not prove physical causality.
This post-review protocol is frozen before its new batch, not before observing the original catalogues or review.
